# relationship interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/relationshipInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which an interpersonal relationship held. (A relator carries its period this way rather than via [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md), which is reserved for [gufo:Situation-based](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation-based) time-scoped relations.)

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md) from [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md), [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to scope an interpersonal-relationship relator in time — the span over which the tie held — as a first-class [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md) here (that is reserved for [gufo:Situation-based](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation-based) time-scoped relations) and avoid putting the interval on the flat shortcut edges (use gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on those statements).

### How to use

- Point the relator at its [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md); this is the relator-native way to carry a period, distinct from the situation-based [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md) idiom.

### Examples

- ex:tie [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md) ex:collabInterval.
